VERCEL MULTI-VIEWER ARCHITECTURE

Cloud Database Sync (Supabase Postgres / REST Endpoint)

All changes persist automatically in your browser's local database AND can sync with a live Supabase PostgreSQL database so thousands of viewers on your Vercel URL see live updates the moment the Umpire clicks Publish.

PostgreSQL / Supabase Table Setup Script (`cricpulse_state`) 
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS public.cricpulse_series_store (
  series_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT 'default_series',
  series_name TEXT NOT NULL,
  payload JSONB NOT NULL,
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);
ALTER TABLE public.cricpulse_series_store ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY "Public Read Access" ON public.cricpulse_series_store FOR SELECT USING (true);
CREATE POLICY "Admin Upsert Access" ON public.cricpulse_series_store FOR ALL USING (true);

Database Storage Inspector

Real-time record counts stored in `CricPulseDB`

How Vercel Deployment Works:

1. Deploy the included project folder to Vercel (zero build config required).

2. Connect your free Supabase URL & Key above or export/commit `database.json`.

3. Viewers see instant live scorecards, NRR tables, and 1-click PDF downloads.
